name: Rundown
description: A few leaks here and there and could use a bit of sprucing up, but functional. Gotta start somewhere!

name: Basic
description: Comes with a fresh coat of paint and some plants. Also has working lights now. Not too fancy, but being standard is better than nothing!

name: Elevated
description: Has outdoor seating and taller plants. It is fancy, crispy, luxurious, and well illuminated!

name: Classy
description: More seats galore! Very pristine and is the equivalent of fine dining for bakeries. Quite expensive, but well worth the cost!
